description: Classic male bodybuilding proportions: John McCallum's (chest 6.5 × wrist; waist 70%, hips 85%, thigh 53%, arm 36%, neck 37%, calf 34% of chest) and Steve Reeves' ratios (arm 252% wrist, calf 192% ankle, neck 79% head, chest 148% and waist 86% pelvis, thigh 175% knee). Aesthetic ideals, not health measures or tested targets.
